q1: "What does the reported tail-DNA evidence establish about genotype uniformity in albino hybrid founder #30?" Evidence: Tail-DNA analysis identified multiple mutant alleles in completely albino hybrid founder #30. Authors attribute within-founder diversity to mosaicism, potentially from editing persisted into cleavage stages. Deep sequencing reported 57 mutant alleles across 23 founders; not 57 animals. Records mention reported_alleles_in_founder_30=5 prose; publisher Figure 3C lists six allele entries. exact total remains unresolved. But q1 asks genotype uniformity in albino hybrid founder #30. Options: uniform_one_allele_pair (all sampled cells one common pair; albinism establishes uniform mutant genotype), within_founder_mosaicism (different mutant alleles occur within same founder, so complete albinism does not establish one uniform mutant genotype), one_founder_per_allele, no_edit_detected, other, not_stated, conflicting.

Evidence clearly: multiple mutant alleles in same founder #30; authors attribute within-founder diversity to mosaicism. Despite count discrepancy 5 vs 6 unresolved exact total, not incompatible about judgment? It establishes within-founder mosaicism. The exact allele count conflict (5 vs 6) does not contradict existence of multiple alleles/mosaicism; both >1. So q1 = within_founder_mosaicism. Not conflicting because unresolved exact total doesn't give incompatible accounts of uniformity; both agree multiple. Need choose substantive.

q2: "Why would albino offspring from an albino-mate cross not, by phenotype alone, identify transmission of a newly induced allele in the hybrid pigmentation mosaics?" Evidence: C57BL/6N mosaics produced albino progeny in crosses with albino mates. Hybrid pigmentation mosaics were not tested this way: they already carried FVB/NJ albino allele, which could produce albino offspring without demonstrating transmission of a newly induced allele. Somatic evidence and C57 crosses do not establish new-allele transmission for untested hybrids.
Options: preexisting_albino_allele exactly matches: already carry inherited albino allele, so same offspring phenotype need not identify newly induced allele. unique_new_allele_marker opposite. no_germline_possible no. all_hybrid_alleles_verified no. conflicting no. q2=preexisting_albino_allele.
